listen_addresses.description: IP addresses and port(s) the DNS server will listen on for standard DNS traffic (UDP/TCP).

doh_enabled.description: Enable DNS over HTTPS (DoH) support. Requires valid TLS certificate and key paths below.

doh_address.description: Address and port for DoH endpoint (e.g., '0.0.0.0:443').

doh_certs.description: Path to TLS certificate for DoH (PEM format).

doh_key.description: Path to TLS private key for DoH (PEM format).

dot_enabled.description: Enable DNS over TLS (DoT) support. Requires valid TLS certificate and key paths below.

dot_address.description: Address and port for DoT endpoint (e.g., '0.0.0.0:853').

dot_certs.description: Path to TLS certificate for DoT (PEM format).

dot_key.description: Path to TLS private key for DoT (PEM format).

upstream_mode.description: Resolver upstream behavior: 'system' (use system resolvers), or 'custom' (specify upstreams manually).

upstreams.description: List of upstream DNS resolvers to use when upstream_mode is 'custom'. This is a deprecated key. Use the 'upstream' key with a list of 'resolver::UpstreamConfig' objects instead, which allows specifying protocol (TCP, UDP, TLS, HTTPS) and trust anchors. Example: upstream = [{address = '1.1.1.1:53', proto = 'UDP'}]. See https://github.com/hickory-dns/hickory-dns/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#upstreams for details.

cache_size.description: Maximum number of DNS records to hold in the resolver cache.

min_ttl.description: Minimum TTL (seconds) enforced for cached records (prevents overly short caching).

max_ttl.description: Maximum TTL (seconds) enforced for cached records (e.g., 7 days).

recursive_query_mode.description: Recursive query handling: 'off' (refuse recursion), 'local_only' (allow recursion for local/private zones), or 'full' (allow full recursion).

hosted_zones.description: List of authoritative zones served by this server. Each zone defines its own zone file and optional settings.

rate_limit_enabled.description: Enable per-client query rate limiting to mitigate abuse or DDoS.

rate_limit_max_qps.description: Maximum queries per second allowed per client before throttling.

rate_limit_window.description: Time window (seconds) over which QPS is measured.
